confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Mérida's pricing, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies by neighbourhood, season and booking channel; the 3-star and private-room anchors are the least certain. FX was taken from search-result summaries of the RBA exchange-rates page. I did not open the RBA page directly, and one result carried an ambiguous staleness tag on the 16 October figure.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against other mid-sized Mexican colonial cities with domestic and international tourism, such as Oaxaca and Puebla, with Yucatán tourism pricing as a modifier. Mérida is generally cheaper than Cancún or Tulum for both food and lodging.
